files.README.md:
# NVIDIA Transcribe

Read an audio folder and produce complete Markdown transcripts using
`nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-NVFP4`. The conservative default
requires one NVIDIA Blackwell GPU with 96 GiB memory and a Linux runtime. This
NVFP4 checkpoint cannot run on a 48 GB L40S or substitute another precision.

The coworker accepts WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG and M4A, including nested folders. It
freezes a source snapshot, normalizes audio to 16 kHz mono, transcribes every
ordered 300-second chunk through the SDK model journal and saves one
`transcripts/<relative filename>.md` per input. The authoritative
`transcription_result.json` records hashes, durations, model revision, coverage
times, empty-response flags and durable transcript references. A failed or
truncated response fails the batch; saved responses are not dispatched twice.

```bash
mn blueprint run ./nvidia_transcribe --set inputs.payload.input_folder=/absolute/path/audio
```

Select the bundled sample to use `examples/sample_inputs/Bdb001.interaction.wav`,
copied in full from the user-provided recording. It is about 50 minutes long,
16 kHz mono PCM, and is neither synthetic audio nor an observed transcript.
Its SHA-256 and duration are in `examples/sample_source.json`. The recording
is excluded from the model build context; no source recording is published with
the container image. The sample's inclusion does not grant public redistribution.

Inputs are bounded to 100 audio files, 2 GiB total, 256 MiB and one hour per file.
Non-PCM formats use the worker's FFmpeg with a 180-second deadline. No file is
silently truncated. Chunk headings mark input times and may divide words; they
are not word-level alignments or speaker identification. Review important text.

Workers use Python 3.12 and a lightweight Docker image. The independent model
image uses Python 3.13, CUDA 13.2, vLLM 0.32.0 and pinned NeMo Speech. The
model recipe pins the published `homerquan/nvidia-transcribe` image by SHA-256,
with Linux amd64 and arm64 variants. Rebuild sources are in `payloads/model/`;
ordinary use pulls the image automatically. The SDK starts it only for the first transcription, downloads
the pinned NVFP4 checkpoint and caches weights and kernels under its managed
volume. Job preparation, folder discovery and audio normalization do not download
model weights. Model and worker operations reuse the Job allocation.

```bash
synapsy verify ./nvidia_transcribe --workspace /path/to/mirror-neuron-set --compile --python /path/to/runtime/python
python -m pytest nvidia_transcribe/tests -q
```

Created using Synapse's concrete-plan `synapsy create --plan` path. Offline checks
cover compiled dispatch, full chunk coverage, Markdown, immutable snapshots,
replay and explicit failure. CUDA startup, NVFP4 kernels and transcript quality
require separate live qualification; no live transcript is bundled.

# NVIDIA Transcribe coworker specification

Transcribe every supported recording in an authorized staged audio folder to one
Markdown file, preserving relative names and appending `.md`. The required exact
model is `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-NVFP4`, revision
`66c6adc4020179567074d0399cda2a4eeb2bb347`. No alternate model or precision is used.

One stock domain-operation step owns folder policy and reporting. Reusable audio
preparation and model request construction belong to `nvidia_transcribe_skill`.
The SDK owns immutable file snapshots, per-chunk effect journals, model admission,
placement, installation and result delivery. Domain hooks never invoke Docker or
implement workflow routing, retries, ACKs or logical completion.

Limits are 100 files, 2 GiB total, 256 MiB and one hour per file. Every decoded
sample is included exactly once in ordered chunks of up to 300 seconds. Native
16 kHz mono PCM WAV is read directly; other formats use bounded FFmpeg decoding.
Model requests fit the SDK binary payload bounds. Output text is at most 4 MiB
per recording. Stop/length/refusal validation rejects incomplete responses.

Completion requires all transcript Markdown files and `transcription_result.json`
to be durably published. The index binds file hashes, durations, exact chunk
coverage, the pinned model and transcript references. Empty responses are
qualified explicitly. A failed file prevents successful batch completion; partial
private work remains available for recovery. Replays use captured source and
committed responses, including when original files change after capture.

Requirements: Linux, NVIDIA Blackwell, conservative 96 GiB GPU memory floor,
8 CPU cores, 16 GiB CPU RAM and 100 GiB disk. Serving startup checks actual
Blackwell capability. Python 3.12 workers and the isolated Python 3.13 upstream
model environment are separate. Model weights are installed lazily on first
required request; images contain serving code only. The admitted Job allocation
covers all worker/model work. Inputs and transcripts are confidential.

The bundled sample is the user's full Bdb001.interaction.wav recording with
hash/duration provenance. It is excluded from public model images. Acceptance
requires complete coverage and correct output receipts in offline fixtures, and
a separate representative live transcript on the intended Blackwell node.
Word alignment, persistent speaker identities, live streaming and accuracy
guarantees are outside this coworker's contract.

# NVIDIA Transcribe user manual

Choose an authorized local folder containing WAV, FLAC, MP3, OGG or M4A files.
Nested folders are supported. Or select the bundled Bdb001.interaction.wav sample,
about 50 minutes of audio. Start a run with normal Job controls; Chat never starts
work by itself. The coworker writes one `transcripts/<relative filename>.md` per
recording and an authoritative `transcription_result.json` inventory.

It transcribes every file completely in ordered 300-second chunks. Heading times
mark input coverage, not word alignments. Transcripts preserve spoken wording and
may contain errors, especially at chunk boundaries or with overlapping speakers.
An empty model response is marked explicitly; no speech is invented to fill it.

Limits: 100 audio files, 2 GiB total input, 256 MiB and one hour per recording.
Requires a Linux NVIDIA Blackwell node; default memory floor is 96 GiB, based on
NVIDIA's documented NVFP4 profile. A generic 48 GB NVIDIA GPU is insufficient for
this exact checkpoint. The first transcription installs/reuses the pinned model
through the SDK; later runs use its cache. Audio is sent only to that managed
node. The model image does not contain the sample recording.

Inspect `get_run_status` and `get_run_results` for observed completion. A failed
file rejects completion; the batch index is published only after every recording
has a complete saved transcript. Pausing/stopping uses normal Job controls.

"""Folder transcription policy; the SDK journals model calls and publication."""

from pathlib import Path

from mn_nvidia_transcribe_skill import (
    MODEL_REVISION,
    SOURCE_MODEL,
    build_transcription_request,
    parse_completion,
    prepare_audio,
    scan_audio_folder,
)
from mn_sdk.blueprint.context import source_manifest
from mn_sdk.blueprint.hooks import fingerprint
from mn_sdk.blueprint.inputs import capture_declared_inputs
from mn_sdk.blueprint.models import model_request
from mn_sdk.blueprint.outputs import capture_file, materialize_file, publish_artifact_bundle
from mn_sdk_common.publication import ArtifactWrite


def _snapshot(block, folder):
    records = []
    for path in scan_audio_folder(folder):
        block.check()
        relative = path.relative_to(folder).as_posix()
        ref = capture_file(block, path, key=relative)
        info = block.store.read(ref)
        records.append(
            {
                "source": relative,
                "source_sha256": info["sha256"],
                "size_bytes": info["size_bytes"],
                "file": ref.to_dict(),
            }
        )
    return records


def _chunks(block, item, seconds):
    source = materialize_file(
        block,
        item["file"],
        path=block.root
        + "/audio-inputs/"
        + fingerprint(item["source"])
        + Path(item["source"]).suffix,
    )
    with prepare_audio(source, chunk_seconds=seconds) as document:
        if document.source_sha256 != item["source_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("Audio snapshot does not match its source hash")
        chunks = []
        for chunk in document.chunks():
            block.check()
            ref = block.store.commit_bytes(
                block.root
                + "/audio-chunks/"
                + fingerprint(item["source"])
                + "/"
                + str(chunk.index)
                + ".wav",
                chunk.wav_bytes,
                kind="transcription_chunk",
            )
            chunks.append(
                {
                    "index": chunk.index,
                    "start_seconds": chunk.start_seconds,
                    "end_seconds": chunk.end_seconds,
                    "audio": ref.to_dict(),
                }
            )
        return {"duration_seconds": document.duration_seconds, "chunks": chunks}


def _time(seconds):
    milliseconds = round(seconds * 1000)
    hours, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 3600000)
    minutes, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 60000)
    seconds, milliseconds = divmod(milliseconds, 1000)
    return f"{hours:02}:{minutes:02}:{seconds:02}.{milliseconds:03}"


def run(block, inputs):
    inputs = capture_declared_inputs(block, inputs, runtime_file=__file__)
    folder = Path(inputs.get("input_folder") or "")
    if not folder.is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("An absolute staged audio folder is required")
    seconds = inputs.get("chunk_seconds", 300)
    if type(seconds) is not int or not 1 <= seconds <= 300:
        raise ValueError("chunk_seconds must be 1–300")
    inventory_path = block.root + "/audio-inventory.json"
    inventory = block.read_checkpoint(
        block.freeze_checkpoint(inventory_path, lambda: _snapshot(block, folder)),
        expected_path=inventory_path,
    )
    declaration = source_manifest(__file__)["runtime"]["models"]["transcribe"]
    prepared_inputs = []
    for item in inventory:
        block.check()
        prepared_path = block.root + "/prepared-audio/" + fingerprint(item["source"]) + ".json"
        prepared = block.read_checkpoint(
            block.freeze_checkpoint(prepared_path, lambda item=item: _chunks(block, item, seconds)),
            expected_path=prepared_path,
        )
        prepared_inputs.append((item, prepared))
    if sum(len(prepared["chunks"]) for _, prepared in prepared_inputs) >= block.max_calls:
        raise ValueError("Audio inventory exceeds the declared model call budget")
    writes, records = [], []
    for item, prepared in prepared_inputs:
        block.check()
        sections, chunks, text_bytes = [], [], 0
        for chunk in prepared["chunks"]:
            block.check()
            request = build_transcription_request(block.store.read_bytes(chunk["audio"]))
            request["model"] = declaration["model"]
            request["payload"]["model"] = declaration["model_spec"]["api_model"]
            request["options"].update(
                provider=declaration["provider"],
                backend=declaration["backend"],
                model_spec=declaration["model_spec"],
            )
            request["payload"]["messages"][0]["content"][1]["audio_url"]["url"] = {
                "$artifact": chunk["audio"],
                "encoding": "data_uri",
                "mime_type": "audio/wav",
            }
            response = model_request(
                block, request, key=fingerprint([item["source"], chunk["index"]])
            )
            text = parse_completion(response)
            text_bytes += len(text.encode())
            if text_bytes > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
                raise ValueError("Transcript exceeds 4 MiB per recording")
            sections.append(
                "## "
                + _time(chunk["start_seconds"])
                + " – "
                + _time(chunk["end_seconds"])
                + "\n\n"
                + (text or "[No transcript text returned for this chunk.]")
            )
            chunks.append(
                {
                    "index": chunk["index"],
                    "start_seconds": chunk["start_seconds"],
                    "end_seconds": chunk["end_seconds"],
                    "empty": not bool(text),
                }
            )
        markdown = (
            "# Audio transcript\n\nSource: "
            + item["source"]
            + "\n\nSource SHA-256: "
            + item["source_sha256"]
            + "\n\nModel: "
            + SOURCE_MODEL
            + "\n\nModel revision: "
            + MODEL_REVISION
            + "\n\nTimes label input chunks; they are not word alignments. Chunk boundaries may split words.\n\n"
            + "\n\n".join(sections)
            + "\n"
        )
        path = "transcripts/" + item["source"] + ".md"
        transcript = block.store.commit_bytes(path, markdown.encode(), kind="markdown")
        writes.append(
            ArtifactWrite(
                "transcript-" + fingerprint(item["source"]),
                path,
                block.store.read_bytes(transcript),
                kind="markdown",
                authoritative=True,
            )
        )
        records.append(
            {
                "source": item["source"],
                "source_sha256": item["source_sha256"],
                "duration_seconds": prepared["duration_seconds"],
                "transcript": transcript.to_dict(),
                "chunks": chunks,
            }
        )
    report = {
        "schema": "mn.nvidia_transcribe.batch.v1",
        "source_model": SOURCE_MODEL,
        "model_revision": MODEL_REVISION,
        "file_count": len(records),
        "files": records,
    }
    reference = block.store.commit("transcription_result.json", report, kind="transcription_result")
    writes.append(
        ArtifactWrite(
            "transcription_result",
            "transcription_result.json",
            block.store.read_bytes(reference),
            kind="transcription_result",
            authoritative=True,
        )
    )
    publish_artifact_bundle(block, writes, receipt_path=block.root + "/publication.json")
    return {"report": reference.to_dict(), "file_count": len(records)}

# Separate model service: workers use Python 3.12; the upstream serving lock uses 3.13.
FROM nvidia/cuda:13.2.0-devel-ubuntu24.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git ca-certificates curl build-essential libsndfile1 libgomp1 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.9.9 /uv /uvx /usr/local/bin/
RUN git init /opt/nemo && git -C /opt/nemo remote add origin https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Speech.git && \
    git -C /opt/nemo fetch --depth 1 origin 9b3fc483286e428e93d4426fb08599e89b8d46e3 && \
    git -C /opt/nemo checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
WORKDIR /opt/nemo
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv uv venv --python 3.13 .venv && \
    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/nemo/.venv uv sync --extra asr --extra vllm --locked --no-install-project && \
    uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps -e .
# Ignore the training project's OpenCV exclusion for these explicitly required extras.
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv uv --no-config pip install --python .venv/bin/python --no-deps av==19.0.2 opencv-python-headless==5.0.0.93
# Cross builds check metadata without executing target CUDA/CPU kernels in QEMU.
RUN .venv/bin/python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('vllm') == '0.32.0'; assert m.version('opencv-python-headless') == '5.0.0.93'; assert any(e.name == 'nemo_speechlm' for e in m.entry_points(group='vllm.general_plugins'))"
COPY serve.py /opt/serve.py
ENV PATH=/opt/nemo/.venv/bin:/usr/local/cuda/bin:${PATH} \
    HF_HOME=/cache/huggingface HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 \
    VLLM_PLUGINS=nemo_speechlm VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_DECODE_DURATION_S=3600 \
    VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_CLIP_FILESIZE_MB=180 VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 \
    VLLM_DISABLED_KERNELS=FlashInferFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel
EXPOSE 8000
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/nemo/.venv/bin/python", "/opt/serve.py"]
files.payloads/model/serve.py:
"""Trusted serving entrypoint; only SDK first-use startup reaches this code."""

import os

SOURCE_MODEL = "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-NVFP4"
MODEL_REVISION = "66c6adc4020179567074d0399cda2a4eeb2bb347"


def main():
    import torch

    if not torch.cuda.is_available() or torch.cuda.get_device_capability()[0] not in {
        10,
        12,
    }:
        raise RuntimeError("This exact NVFP4 checkpoint requires NVIDIA Blackwell")
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download

    # Never fetch the BF16/FP8 siblings or an unpinned main revision.
    directory = snapshot_download(
        repo_id=SOURCE_MODEL, revision=MODEL_REVISION, max_workers=4
    )
    command = [
        "/opt/nemo/.venv/bin/vllm",
        "serve",
        directory,
        "--served-model-name",
        SOURCE_MODEL,
        "--host",
        "0.0.0.0",
        "--port",
        "8000",
        "--trust-remote-code",
        "--dtype",
        "bfloat16",
        "--kv-cache-dtype",
        "fp8",
        "--gpu-memory-utilization",
        "0.85",
        "--max-model-len",
        "65536",
        "--max-num-batched-tokens",
        "4096",
        "--max-num-seqs",
        "64",
        "--enable-chunked-prefill",
        "--no-enable-prefix-caching",
        "--use-replayssm",
        "--mamba-backend",
        "flashinfer",
        "--mamba-cache-mode",
        "none",
        "--mm-processor-cache-gb",
        "0",
        "--no-async-scheduling",
        "--limit-mm-per-prompt",
        '{"audio":{"count":1,"length":57600000}}',
        "--speculative-config",
        '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":8}',
        "--reasoning-parser",
        "nemotron_v3",
    ]
    os.execv(command[0], command)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Compiled worker, complete chunk coverage, replay and failure tests."""

import io
import json
import sys
import wave
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from mn_sdk.blueprints import compile_blueprint, read_blueprint, resolve_config
from mn_sdk.blueprints.worker_descriptors import resolved_worker_descriptor
from mn_sdk.integrations.block_worker import run
from mn_sdk.step_runtime import StepContext
from mn_sdk_common.committed_artifacts import CommittedJsonStore

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


@pytest.fixture
def worker(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.syspath_prepend(str(ROOT / "payloads"))
    for name in list(sys.modules):
        if name == "domain" or name.startswith("domain."):
            monkeypatch.delitem(sys.modules, name)
    package = read_blueprint(ROOT)
    config = resolve_config(package)
    compiled = compile_blueprint(package, config).manifest
    descriptor = tmp_path / "manifest.json"
    descriptor.write_text(json.dumps(resolved_worker_descriptor(package, compiled, config)))
    node = next(
        n
        for n in compiled["agents"]["nodes"]
        if n.get("config", {}).get("environment", {}).get("MN_WORKFLOW_STEP_HANDLER")
        == "mn_sdk.integrations.block_worker"
    )
    parameters = json.loads(node["config"]["environment"]["MN_WORKFLOW_STEP_WITH_JSON"])
    environment = {
        "MN_RUN_DIR": str(tmp_path / "run"),
        "MN_BLUEPRINT_MANIFEST_PATH": str(descriptor),
        "MN_SDK_COMPONENTS_JSON": '["blueprint-blocks"]',
    }
    for key, value in environment.items():
        monkeypatch.setenv(key, value)
    folder = tmp_path / "audio"
    folder.mkdir()
    output = io.BytesIO()
    with wave.open(output, "wb") as handle:
        handle.setparams((1, 2, 16000, 0, "NONE", "not compressed"))
        handle.writeframes(b"\0\0" * 36000)
    (folder / "sample.wav").write_bytes(output.getvalue())
    calls = []

    def request(*args, **options):
        calls.append((args, options))
        return {
            "choices": [
                {
                    "finish_reason": "stop",
                    "message": {
                        "role": "assistant",
                        "content": "Synthetic transcript " + str(len(calls)),
                    },
                }
            ]
        }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "mn_sdk.integrations.block_model_request.runtime_model_json_request", request
    )
    inputs = {"input_folder": str(folder), "chunk_seconds": 1}

    def execute():
        return run(
            StepContext(
                step_id="transcribe_audio_folder",
                agent_id=node["node_id"],
                run_id="audio-test",
                idempotency_key="audio-test/transcribe",
                config=config.data,
                environment=environment,
                message={"body": {"step_input": inputs}},
            ),
            **parameters,
        )

    return SimpleNamespace(
        execute=execute,
        calls=calls,
        store=CommittedJsonStore(tmp_path / "run"),
        folder=folder,
        inputs=inputs,
    )


def test_complete_markdown_transcripts_and_replay(worker):
    first = worker.execute()
    assert worker.execute() == first
    assert len(worker.calls) == 3
    saved = worker.store.read_path("transcription_result.json")
    record = saved["files"][0]
    assert record["duration_seconds"] == 2.25
    assert [(p["start_seconds"], p["end_seconds"]) for p in record["chunks"]] == [
        (0, 1),
        (1, 2),
        (2, 2.25),
    ]
    text = worker.store.path("transcripts/sample.wav.md").read_text()
    assert all("Synthetic transcript " + str(n) in text for n in (1, 2, 3))
    assert "00:00:02.250" in text
    args, options = worker.calls[0]
    assert args[2] == "/chat/completions"
    assert args[3]["messages"][0]["content"][1]["audio_url"]["url"].startswith(
        "data:audio/wav;base64,"
    )
    assert options["num_retries"] == 0
    assert options["model_spec"]["docker"]["cache_path"] == "/cache"
    assert "Synthetic transcript" not in json.dumps(first.outputs)


def test_publication_failure_recovers_without_repeating_audio_inference(worker, monkeypatch):
    import domain.transcription as domain

    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(
            domain,
            "publish_artifact_bundle",
            lambda *a, **k: (_ for _ in ()).throw(OSError("interrupted delivery")),
        )
        with pytest.raises(OSError):
            worker.execute()
    (worker.folder / "sample.wav").write_bytes(b"changed source after durable capture")
    worker.execute()
    assert len(worker.calls) == 3
    assert worker.store.path("transcription_result.json").exists()


def test_truncated_completion_never_publishes_complete_batch(worker, monkeypatch):
    def request(*args, **options):
        worker.calls.append(args)
        return {"choices": [{"finish_reason": "length", "message": {"content": "Partial words"}}]}

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "mn_sdk.integrations.block_model_request.runtime_model_json_request", request
    )
    for _ in range(2):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="truncated"):
            worker.execute()
    assert len(worker.calls) == 1
    assert not worker.store.path("transcription_result.json").exists()


def test_empty_folder_never_prepares_model(worker):
    (worker.folder / "sample.wav").unlink()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no supported"):
        worker.execute()
    assert not worker.calls


def test_sample_is_complete_original_recording():
    metadata = json.loads((ROOT / "examples/sample_source.json").read_text())
    path = ROOT / "examples/sample_inputs/Bdb001.interaction.wav"
    if not path.exists():
        pytest.skip("Binary sample is staged immediately after Synapsy creation")
    import hashlib

    assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == metadata["sha256"]
    with wave.open(str(path)) as audio:
        assert audio.getnframes() / audio.getframerate() == metadata["duration_seconds"]


def test_declared_local_staging_preserves_audio_files(tmp_path):
    from mn_sdk.blueprint_support.local_inputs import stage_local_input_payloads

    folder = tmp_path / "staged-audio"
    folder.mkdir()
    (folder / "recording.wav").write_bytes(b"fake-wav-for-staging")
    (folder / "recording.mp3").write_bytes(b"fake-mp3-for-staging")
    (folder / "notes.md").write_text("not an audio input")
    config = json.loads((ROOT / "config/default.json").read_text())
    config["inputs"]["payload"]["input_folder"] = str(folder)
    payloads = {}
    report = stage_local_input_payloads(config, payloads, bundle_dir=ROOT)
    assert report["folders"][0]["file_count"] == 2
    assert {Path(name).suffix for name in payloads} == {".wav", ".mp3"}

name: NVIDIA Transcribe
rationale: One bounded stock block composes reusable transcription mechanics, SDK file capture and durable model requests; the model stays on its admitted Blackwell node.
sandbox: Stock Docker workers read only the explicitly staged audio folder and write through SDK stores. FFmpeg processes bounded local bytes without shell invocation. The independent, pinned CUDA serving image executes trusted vLLM/NeMo startup and requires Blackwell. The SDK owns model installation and effect journals; audio and the bundled sample are excluded from the public image build context. Model and workers reuse the admitted Job GPU allocation.
tagline: Turn an audio folder into complete Markdown transcripts

steps.goal: Transcribe every recording completely and publish Markdown with source/coverage receipts.
